thread:
nora: Hey team, day 2 and I9m stuck. Accepted the org invite, enabled 2FA, SSO looks green, but `git push` to redwood-inference/cli keeps failing with 403. Error shows `remote: error: GH006` then `fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/': The requested URL returned error: 403`. Any quick tips?
rahul: Welcome! Two quick checks: which GH user does `ssh -T git@github.com` show? And are you using HTTPS or SSH for that repo?
nora: I cloned via SSH. `ssh -T` says `Hi nora_personal!` even though my org invite used nora@redwood.com. I added a work key but my laptop still picks the personal one.
rahul: Sounds like SSH key order/agent issue. If you use an SSH agent it might be offering the personal key first. Either add the work key to the agent (`ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood`) or make an SSH config entry that forces the work key for GitHub host alias. Example: 
``` 
Host github-redwood
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
  IdentitiesOnly yes
```
Then `git remote set-url origin git@github-redwood:redwood-inference/cli.git` to use that alias.
nora: I tried `ssh-add` but my mac uses the macOS keychain and kept re-offering the personal key. I added the host alias and updated remote, `ssh -T` now shows `Hi nora.work!` but push still blocked by GH006.
infra-bot: Running membership-sync for nora@redwood.com... 2FA: enabled, SSO: accepted, Teams: engineering-read.
rahul: GH006 can be branch protection. Are you pushing to main directly? We have a repo-level rule: push to protected branches requires maintainer permissions. Which team do you need?
nora: I need to land a small README fix then a CI tweak; thought I had write access.
oliver: I checked mapping: engineering-read is read-only. I can add you to cli-contrib (write) if that's ok. @nora want that?
nora: Yes please.
oliver: Added you to cli-contrib. Wait ~90s for GitHub to update. Also FYI if you ever use the GitHub CLI, `gh auth status` helps surface which account is active. VS Code credential helper can sometimes cache the wrong HTTPS creds too.
nora: After the team add I could push a branch. Tried to push to main again and got blocked as expected; opened PR and got it merged. All set now. Thanks!
devex: Quick follow-up: updating onboarding email and internal checklist to call out three explicit items: 1) Accept SSO on github.com (purple banner), 2) Ensure your local SSH/credential helper maps to your work account (examples for SSH config + `gh auth login` + `ssh-add`), 3) Confirm expected team mapping and who to ping for repo perms. Adding note about macOS keychain behavior.
nora: Love that, saved me time. Also adding a short note in the repo CONTRIBUTING.md about using host alias for SSH to avoid confusion.
